page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-180-lssd is a high-capacity server instance powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9B14 processors. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture, this configuration provides 180 virtual CPUs across 90 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system is equipped with 720 GB of RAM, translating to a resource density of 4.0 GB of memory per core. Storage is bundled directly with the instance, featuring 16 local NVMe SSDs that deliver a combined capacity of 6432 GB.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier performance across multiple compute and memory metrics. The multi-core CPU performance, measured via stress-ng and Geekbench, ranks in the top 10% of tested systems. Memory subsystem performance is similarly robust, with small-block read-only bandwidth reaching top-tier levels and large-block read/write bandwidth placing in the top 25%. The processor supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 vector and neural network instructions, which contribute to top-tier scores in cryptographic operations, physics simulations, and software compilation.

This instance is highly optimized for data-intensive workloads that require substantial local storage throughput and high parallel processing power. It demonstrates top-tier performance in Redis operations, static web serving throughput, and large language model inference tasks, particularly for prompt processing and text generation on medium to large models. Given the high density of dedicated CPU cores, substantial memory, and integrated high-speed NVMe storage, the instance offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for enterprise database hosting, real-time analytics, and heavy parallel compilation tasks without the overhead of external storage attachments.
